NV-2027-SB4.title: Revises provisions relating to state financial administration. (BDR 31-449)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Government Affairs. To printer.

NV-2027-SB4.description: AN ACT relating to state financial administration; authorizing certain agencies of the Executive Department of State Government to charge a late payment fee and interest on certain debts; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-SB4.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-SB4.aiSummary: The bill would let certain Executive Branch agencies charge a late fee and interest on some debts. It affects state agencies that collect money owed to the state. It also covers other related changes to state financial rules.

NV-2027-SB20.title: Revises provisions relating to indigent defense. (BDR 14-143)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Judiciary. To printer.

NV-2027-SB20.description: AN ACT relating to indigent defense; revising provisions relating to the private practice of law by a deputy state public defender; requiring the Board on Indigent Defense Services to adopt regulations under certain circumstances; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-SB20.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-SB20.aiSummary: The bill would change rules for indigent defense, which is legal help for people who cannot afford a lawyer. It would update when a deputy state public defender can do private law work. It would also require the Board on Indigent Defense Services to adopt rules in some cases.

NV-2027-SB13.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)

NV-2027-AB5.title: Revises provisions relating to certain mining claims, mill sites and tunnel rights. (BDR 46-157)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Natural Resources. To printer.

NV-2027-AB5.description: AN ACT relating to maps; requiring a county recorder to submit to the Division of Minerals of the Commission on Mineral Resources an electronic version of certain maps filed with the county recorder during the calendar quarter; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-AB5.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-AB5.aiSummary: The bill would require county recorders to send an electronic copy of certain maps filed with them each calendar quarter to the Division of Minerals. It affects county recorders and the state office that handles mineral resources.

NV-2027-AB16.title: Revises provisions relating to probation. (BDR 14-160)

actions.text: Prefiled. Referred to Committee on Judiciary. To printer.

NV-2027-AB16.description: AN ACT relating to probation; requiring certain periods of probation or suspension of sentence to run concurrently; revising provisions governing deductions from periods of probation; and providing other matters properly relating thereto.
NV-2027-AB16.descriptionSource: Official alternate title (state legislature, via Open States)
NV-2027-AB16.aiSummary: The bill would change some probation rules. It would require certain probation periods or suspended sentences to run at the same time, instead of one after another. It would also change how time is taken off a probation period.
